sourceClarifications: 26.26–26.28: Rail voltage differs from V_ab. Source polarity and internal observation points are included in nodal checks.
26.57: Open-circuit V_ab is +2/9 V. Both 1 and 3 ohm resistors in the middle branch are retained. An initial cross-review sign objection was disproved by independent nodal solving.
26.63: The specified 2 A direction requires an emf of -108.75 V relative to the depicted polarity, so the physical source must be reversed.
26.67: The exact nodal result gives 4.20 ohms. A small appendix rounding difference is not used to alter the circuit solution.
26.73: The ideal-voltmeter limit is 266.666... V, rounded to 267 V.
26.79: A least-squares fit to all printed data yields R=249.5 ohms and emf=15.98 V. Graph-read rounded answers differ slightly.
26.81: The printed 15.0 V input bias in part c is incompatible with the stated 7.5 V output under the ideal model. The compatible bias is 1.35 V and the incremental gain is -10.
26.85: The printed axon segment is 1.0 micrometre, so 2.0 millimetres contains 2000 segments. Both voltage remaining and fractional decrease are stated.
